name: Repository
description: Repository files, changes, branch context, and pull request context for malini workstreams.

commands.title: Repository: Refresh
commands.description: Refresh the current workstream's repository files.

commands.title: Repository: Refresh Pull Request
commands.description: Refresh only the current workstream's remote pull request and check state.

commands.title: Repository: Prepare Pull Request Fix
commands.description: Refresh the exact pull request head and read bounded diagnostics for an in-Malini agent fix. When the pull request conflicts with its target branch, merge the target branch into the workstream and leave the conflicts for the agent to resolve.

commands.title: Repository: Pull Latest Target Branch
commands.description: Update the workstream from its target branch, push, and refresh pull request state. A conflicting update stays in the workstream for the agent to resolve.

commands.title: Repository: Continue After Merge
commands.description: Move a workstream whose pull request merged onto its fresh target branch, keeping uncommitted edits and any commits made after the merge, so the next push opens a new pull request.

commands.title: Repository: Abort Merge
commands.description: Abort the merge in progress in the workstream and return it to the last commit.

commands.title: Repository: Mark Pull Request Ready
commands.description: Move the current draft pull request into review without leaving Malini.

commands.title: Repository: Select File
commands.description: Select and read a repository file.

commands.title: Repository: Open File
commands.description: Open a repository file in a tab beside the workstream chats.

commands.title: Repository: Render Diff
commands.description: Load and render repository diffs through the public repository service.

commands.title: Repository: Open Agent Session Diff
commands.description: Open an immutable, run-attributed agent session diff in Files.

commands.title: Repository: Status
commands.description: Return the current repository panel state.

commands.title: Repository: Workstream Todos
commands.description: Return the current bounded workstream todo list for in-Malini context injection.

commands.title: Repository: Add Workstream Todo
commands.description: Add a bounded todo to the current workstream.

commands.title: Repository: Update Workstream Todo
commands.description: Mark a current workstream todo complete or open.

commands.title: Repository: Remove Workstream Todo
commands.description: Remove a todo from the current workstream.

commands.title: Repository: Warm Workstream
commands.description: Read another workstream's repository state ahead of its first visit.

commands.title: Repository: Commit and Push
commands.description: Commit the workstream's pending changes with the derived message and push its branch, without touching the pull request.

commands.title: Repository: Create or Update Pull Request
commands.description: Automatically commit pending changes, push the workstream branch, and create or refresh its pull request inside Malini.

commands.title: Repository: Review Merge
commands.description: Refresh merge readiness, or land the pull request when the caller passes the head revision the human confirmed.

settings.label: Show hidden files
settings.description: Include dotfiles and files inside hidden directories in the Files panel.
